name: Aoyagi Mikado
source:
Part of unit Re:Fly

A student who works various part-time jobs while attending school.
Quick-witted, he is an eccentric gentleman who makes countless perverted jokes. He was held back a year.
He actually comes from a respectable family and is on good terms with his cousin Miyabino Tsubaki.
